method.source: PDBe updated mmCIF, category _struct_ref_seq_dif (deposited vs reference sequence of each polymer entity)
method.why_not_api: PDBe API mutated_AA_or_NA covers protein chains only at present (endpoint description); no RNA records for any family
method.chain_join: author strand (pdbx_pdb_strand_id, else _struct_ref_seq.pdbx_strand_id) + entity -> label asym id via _pdbx_poly_seq_scheme
method.residue: seq_num = label_seq_id; mon_id = deposited residue; db_mon_id = reference residue

change_kinds.added_residue: deposited residue without a reference residue
change_kinds.absent_residue: reference residue without a deposited residue (no seq_num)

method.classification: the deposited _struct_ref_seq_dif.details text, verbatim (case and wording preserved)
checks: deposited residue = residue_name of the validated family mapping
copies of one entity report the same differences
method.consensus_positions: validated family mapping only (match state); insert, flank, local-end, absent and conflicting rows keep a null position
method.counting: one observation per row; per position and classification: distinct RNA chain instances and PDB entries
method.absence: not a negative: most RNA entities reference their own PDB sequence and cannot record differences

provenance.mmcif_source: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pdbe/entry-files/download/<pdb>_updated.cif (PDBe updated mmCIF; per-entry retrieval in entry_sources)
